label: Corrected method: 2011 data with errors against the thesis sources corrected
description: The 2011 data and zones of 2011-corrected with the corrections to the method (errors against the thesis's own sources, no judgement): biodiesel-yield (biodiesel yield from oilseeds: oil content counted once); beef-carcase-yield (beef carcase-to-retail yield restored (0.705)). It shows what the thesis's results would have been without them.
